##### Project general facts

The Pier Residence is an elegant waterfront residential development located in Dubai Maritime City, offering a refined lifestyle where contemporary architecture meets the tranquility of the sea. Inspired by the graceful form of a wave, the building features a striking façade with cascading private balconies that maximize panoramic waterfront views and create a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. Offering a collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, The Pier Residence combines sophisticated design, exceptional craftsmanship, and a prime location with effortless access to Dubai's key business, leisure, and transport hubs.

Residents enjoy a thoughtfully curated selection of world-class amenities designed to promote wellness, relaxation, and an active lifestyle. Set within one of Dubai's most exciting waterfront destinations, the development offers the perfect balance between peaceful coastal living and vibrant city convenience. Beautifully designed communal spaces, premium leisure facilities, and direct access to the surrounding promenade create an environment where every day feels like a resort-style escape.

The residences are finished with high-quality contemporary materials and feature impressive 3.6-meter ceilings, full-height thermal glazing, and integrated Smart Home technology that allows residents to control lighting, air conditioning, curtains, and security directly from their mobile devices. Kitchens are fully fitted with elegant marble or quartz countertops and premium Bosch or Siemens integrated appliances, including a refrigerator, oven, dishwasher, stove, coffee machine, and washing machine. The residences are delivered unfurnished, providing homeowners with the freedom to create interiors that reflect their own personal style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a unique and innovative community located in the heart of Dubai. As a specialized maritime hub, it offers a comprehensive range of services, facilities, and infrastructure to support the maritime industry, making it a prominent destination for maritime-related activities.

Dubai Maritime City is designed to create a conducive environment for businesses and professionals in the maritime sector. The community features state-of-the-art shipyards, dry docks, and repair facilities, catering to the needs of shipbuilding, repair, and maintenance companies. It also offers specialized zones for maritime businesses, including maritime services, marine equipment providers, and maritime education and training institutions.

Dubai Maritime City is strategically located, offering convenient access to major transportation hubs and business districts. The community benefits from its proximity to Dubai's ports, connecting it to global trade routes and facilitating seamless movement of goods and services. Its strategic location ensures efficient logistics and easy connectivity for businesses and residents alike.
